The topology mask shows some fragmentation on the left edge (likely fur strands), which is normal for shaggy animals but can indicate boundary bleeding. The rope structure itself looks geometrically sound. I disagree with the Router's 'no artifacts' conclusion; there are subtle structural ambiguities in the limb articulation and potential minor fusion at the hand-rope interface, though not catastrophic.
